mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, application_id AS applicationId, source_tenant_id AS sourceTenantId, source_order_id AS sourceOrderId, receipt_event_id AS receiptEventId, evidence_version AS evidenceVersion, bound_by AS boundBy, bound_at AS boundAt FROM mk_trade_order_binding WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT event_id AS eventId, evidence_version AS evidenceVersion, currency FROM mk_trade_receipt_inbox WHERE source_tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND source_order_id = #{sourceOrderId} ORDER BY evidence_version DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_trade_order_binding (tenant_id, application_id, source_tenant_id, source_order_id, receipt_event_id, evidence_version, bound_by, bound_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{sourceTenantId}, #{sourceOrderId}, #{receiptEventId}, #{evidenceVersion}, #{boundBy}, #{boundAt})
